architecture.comment: Read architecture-beta at its identifier boundary before entering the architecture body. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and architecture.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata. Follows architecture.md#composite-common-forms.
Read a native YAML region from a three-dash opening fence to the first qualifying unindented closing fence. Follows architecture.md#hidden-forms-and-comments.
Read a native ignored percent-brace region through its earliest brace-percent closer with a following whitespace or end-of-input boundary. Follows architecture.md#hidden-forms-and-comments.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows architecture.md#hidden-forms-and-comments.

Read a bracketed label when its entire value is a matching quoted string. The lookahead applies HTML attribute-quote conversion before checking the bracket; the string context retains source escapes and directives. Separator-led comments end the current value, and a backslash preceding a tag remains text. Follows architecture.md#icons-strings-and-bracketed-labels, common.md#html-attribute-quotes, and common.md#comment-lines.
String escape recognition applies to the complete quoted alternatives of a bracketed label. Follows architecture.md#icons-strings-and-bracketed-labels.

Read an unquoted bracketed label when neither complete quoted form applies. Either square bracket or physical line end bounds it; internal quotes and backslashes stay plain text, and HTML cannot extend the label past its closer. A separator-led common comment stops the current value. Follows architecture.md#icons-strings-and-bracketed-labels and common.md#comment-lines.

Read a possibly empty quoted text icon using matching single or double delimiters. Backslash escapes exclude physical line breaks and line or paragraph separators. Follows architecture.md#icons-strings-and-bracketed-labels.
Read an icon's separate brackets and retained name text. Follows architecture.md#icons-strings-and-bracketed-labels.
Read a group modifier with independent directive scopes between its components. Follows architecture.md#names-keyword-boundaries-and-directions and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Read a listed alignment orientation. Follows architecture.md#grammar.
patterns.name: constant.language.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the junction, service, group, align and in keywords unless the suffix continues an identifier. Follows architecture.md#ordered-rules and architecture.md#names-keyword-boundaries-and-directions.
patterns.name: keyword.control.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read one port-side marker from L, R, T and B even when name characters follow it. Follows architecture.md#names-keyword-boundaries-and-directions.
patterns.name: constant.language.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a bare ASCII name made of letters, digits, underscores and internal dashes. A dash cannot be its final character, and numeric-looking names keep the name scope. Follows architecture.md#names-keyword-boundaries-and-directions and architecture.md#ordered-rules.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read double or single dashes and either angle marker as components of an architecture connection. Follows architecture.md#names-keyword-boundaries-and-directions and architecture.md#grammar.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arrow.mermaid

patterns.comment: The arrow has a colon before its first port direction and after its second; group-modifier is opening brace, group, and closing brace. Follows architecture.md#icons-strings-and-bracketed-labels and architecture.md#grammar.

architecture-string.comment: Read matching single- or double-quoted text with optional empty content. A backslash escapes the next character unless it is a physical line break, line separator or paragraph separator. Follows architecture.md#icons-strings-and-bracketed-labels.

architecture-line-final-keywords.comment: Read a reserved keyword at a statement start when only padding and directives follow on its physical line. A value on a later line receives the surrounding context's scopes. Follows architecture.md#composite-common-forms and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
